title: RCSE v1.4.0 - value-conditional calibration mechanism
description: Reproducible selective-execution study including independent value-bin isotonic calibration, held-out risk diagnostics by PO value, and matched scalar graph selection across twenty calibration splits. Includes preceding full-population, grouped, temporal, permutation and repeated vendor experiments. Manuscripts, reviewer files, editorial helpers and credentials are excluded. Original code is MIT licensed; source-data attribution remains CC BY 4.0.
